name: DriftLight
description: A DTC sleep brand. Flagship product is a sunrise-simulation alarm clock that wakes you with gradual light instead of a jarring buzzer. $129, ships free, 30-night trial. Positioned for people who hate mornings and want to stop snoozing.
target_customer: Busy professionals and parents, 28-45, who struggle to wake up, feel groggy, and have tried multiple alarms. Value sleep quality and are willing to spend on wellness.
